tender.description: Tender for dismantling of 66kV CTs from the spare bay at Andhra, transportation of the CTs from Andhra to Sainj, dismantling of the existing CTs at Sainj, and erection, retrofitting, testing and commissioning of the new CTs, including hiring of a Hyd
